analysis.intent_details: Notification about a Glassdoor community post regarding remote work policies

responses.subject: Re: My friend just quit their dev job because the mandatory "3 days in office" cost...
responses.body: Thank you for sharing this information. We appreciate your feedback regarding workplace policies and their impact on employee retention. Your perspective helps us better understand current workplace trends and challenges.
responses.rationale: A professional acknowledgment maintains appropriate boundaries while validating the sender's input. This response is suitable for a notification email that doesn't require detailed engagement.

responses.subject: Acknowledged: Workplace Policy Feedback
responses.body: We have received your message regarding workplace policy concerns. Your input has been documented in our system for review by the appropriate teams. Should you have any further questions or require additional assistance, please don't hesitate to contact us.
responses.rationale: The formal tone provides a structured response that treats the email as official feedback, ensuring proper documentation while maintaining professional distance.

responses.subject: Thanks for the heads up!
responses.body: Appreciate you sharing this perspective. It's definitely an interesting point about how office policies are affecting people these days. We'll keep this in mind as we monitor workplace trends.
responses.rationale: A more casual approach acknowledges the informal nature of the original message while still providing appropriate recognition of the content shared.
